newsitem.title: LATVIA: Bank of NY, Latvian rail to sign $6.7 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NY, Latvian rail to sign $6.7 mln loan.

text.p: The Bank of New York and Latvian railways will sign a $6.7 million loan on Wednesday guaranteed by the Export-Import Bank (Eximbank), the U.S. Information Service said in a statement.
The loan will be used to modernise the telecommunications network of Latvian railways.
"This is the first time that the Eximbank has guaranteed a loan in Latvia without requiring an additional guarantee from the Latvian government," the statement said.
"Eximbank's willingness to do this represents a strong vote of confidence in Latvia and its economic future."
